answer: The economy spends reputation the way a market spends money: sparingly and against verified performance, so Sybil inflation is filtered out before it can compound into a decisive advantage. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain.. The reason this works is that the attacker must pay a real cost on every identity, so scale becomes a liability rather than an advantage. Consider a lagoon as the anchor of the cost.
